player_prompt.intro:
Keddi Player {player_id} di ekkart {max_rounds} n Kuhn Poker.
Tifawt n Urzag:
- Kuhn Poker ar tettas 3 n warqad aked J, Q, K (J d amezwaru, K d aneggaru)
- Yal asselmad yettaɣ {ante} n tikwal d yettawḍa 1 n warqad yal tikkelt (ɣur-wen-d akken warqad n wassselmad ur yezmir ara ad yili d akken iɣallen-is).
- Urzag ar kettafa {max_rounds} n tikwal
- Asselmad i yesɛan aṭas n tikwal seld n tikwal akk d netta i rebḍa
Tifawt n Tidɣint:
- '[check]': Ffeɣ adɣa n wurrig (kan iɣ ur yelli wurrig ɣef uṣṭaḍ)
- '[bet]': Rnu 1 n tikwal i wurrig (kan iɣ ur yelli wurrig ɣef uṣṭaḍ)
- '[call]': Mmud aselmad nniḍen s wurrig n 1 n tikwal
- '[fold]': Rẓem tafgga n wassselmad d ffeɣ attekki iɣallen-is i rebḍen wurrig
